tasks.instruction: Pick the machined transmission shaft from the inbound tray and seat it into the central assembly jig bore.
Pick the bronze spur gear from the feeder spindle and mesh it onto the transmission shaft in the jig.
Pick the hardened steel dowel pin from the feeder cup and insert it into the locating hole on the assembly jig.
Pick the steel ball bearing ring from the parts tray and press it onto the jig shoulder.
Pick the flange bolt from the feeder cup and insert it into the fixture bolt channel.
Pick the hex nut from the tray and align it onto the threaded stud.
Pick the surface-mount microchip package and seat it into the test socket.
Pick the cylindrical ceramic cartridge fuse and snap it into the fuse clip.
Pick the wiring harness plug connector and insert it into the mating receptacle.
Pick the automotive relay module and plug it into the base socket.
Pick the finished shaft from the fixture and transfer it to the outbound QA pallet.
Pick the assembled spur gear from the jig and transfer it to the outbound pallet.
Pick the dowel pin from the assembly and transfer it to the outbound pallet.
Pick the shaft from the inbound tray and place it into the feeder cup.
Pick the bronze gear and transfer it into the inbound kitting tray.
Pick the dowel pin from the cup and place it into the inbound tray.
Pick the shaft, lift it 15cm, and replace it back into the inbound tray.
Pick the gear from the feeder spindle and replace it centered on the spindle base.
Pick the dowel pin and reposition it upright in the feeder cup.
Kit the machined shaft into compartment 1 on the outbound pallet.
Kit the bronze spur gear into compartment 2 on the outbound pallet.
Kit the steel dowel pin into compartment 3 on the outbound pallet.
Move end-effector to press the emergency stop push button.
Position the wrist camera 12cm directly above the assembly jig for optical inspection dwell.
Position the camera above the outbound pallet for QA verification scan.
Approach the andon stack light tower to confirm green pass status.
Approach and contact the fixture pneumatic clamping vice jaw.
Transfer gear from feeder spindle to workbench staging zone.
Transfer shaft from inbound tray to intermediate staging buffer.
Complete inspection and return arm to the upright ready standby pose.
Pick the grilled beef burger patty from the cast-iron grill and place it onto the bottom bun on the assembly board.
Pick the cheddar cheese slice from the chilled topping tray and place it onto the burger patty.
Pick the fresh tomato slice from the topping tray and place it onto the burger stack.
Pick the sesame top bun crown from the bakery caddy and place it on top of the burger stack.
Pick the bottom bun from the caddy and place it centered onto the assembly cutting board.
Pick the ceramic coffee mug from the storage bin and place it onto the espresso machine drip tray.
Move end-effector forward to press the green brew push-button on the espresso machine.
Pick the golden espresso capsule from the caddy and insert it into the machine hopper slot.
Pick the brewed coffee mug from the drip tray and place it onto the serving breakfast tray.
Pick the cooked patty from the grill and place it directly onto the porcelain dining plate.
Pick tomato slice and place onto porcelain dining plate.
Pick cheese slice and place onto porcelain dining plate.
Pick the coffee capsule pod and transfer it to the breakfast serving tray.
Pick the coffee mug from the tray and return it to the clean storage bin.
Pick the capsule from the serving tray and return it to the pod caddy.
Grasp patty on grill, lift 10cm, and set back down to sear reverse side.
Pick the top bun and place it flat on the assembly board.
Pick tomato slice and place directly onto cutting board.
Pick cheese slice and place directly onto cutting board.
Align gripper over top bun crown and press down gently to settle layers.
Position end-effector camera below brew spout to inspect nozzle cleanliness.
Position camera over grill control indicator to confirm power state.
Restock bottom bun into forward slot of bakery caddy.
Restock sesame crown into rear slot of bakery caddy.
Restock cheddar slice into topping tray rear compartment.
Restock tomato slice into topping tray forward compartment.
Return patty to cast-iron grill station.
Perform linear cleaning sweep across the butcher block island counter.
Clean drip tray surface with linear approach pass.
Retract arm upward and return to high kitchen standby posture.
Pick the red cube block and place it into the red sorting bin.
Pick the green cylinder block and place it into the green sorting bin.
Pick the blue cube block and place it into the blue sorting bin.
Pick the red block and place it into the green bin.
Pick the red block and place it into the blue bin.
Pick the green cylinder and place it into the red bin.
Pick the green cylinder and place it into the blue bin.
Pick the blue block and place it into the red bin.
Pick the blue block and place it into the green bin.
Pick the red block and move it to the table center workspace.
Pick the green cylinder and move it to the table center.
Pick the blue block and move it to the table center.
Pick the red block and place it at the blue block starting position.
Pick the blue block and place it at the green block position.
Pick the green cylinder and place it at the red block position.
Pick the red block and stack it directly on top of the blue block.
Pick the green cylinder and stack it on top of the blue block.
Pick the blue block and stack it on top of the red block.
Position wrist camera 12cm above the red bin for content verification.
Position wrist camera 12cm above the green bin for content verification.
Position wrist camera 12cm above the blue bin for content verification.
Move end-effector to touch the top surface of the red block.
Move end-effector to touch the top of the green cylinder.
Move end-effector to touch the top surface of the blue block.
Pick the red block from the left quadrant and transfer it to the far right quadrant.
Pick the blue block from the right quadrant and transfer it to the far left quadrant.
Pick red block and advance it 10cm forward on the table.
Pick blue block and advance it 10cm forward on the table.
Perform linear cleaning sweep across the tabletop center.
Return arm to the central tabletop ready observation posture.
Pick the 15mL conical reagent tube from rack A and transfer it into destination rack B.
Pick the 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube and load it into the centrifuge rotor slot.
Grasp the micropipette from the benchtop staging rack and lift it upright.
Move micropipette tip precisely over the 96-well assay microplate.
Transfer 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube from staging to secondary rack.
Return conical reagent tube back to primary rack A.
Return microcentrifuge tube from centrifuge to storage rack.
Dock micropipette back onto the central staging stand.
Approach and press the START button on the microcentrifuge control panel.
Hover wrist camera 10cm above 96-well microplate for spectrophotometric density read.
Perform optical inspection dwell over tube rack A.
Perform optical inspection dwell over tube rack B.
Transfer conical tube adjacent to microplate for assay preparation.
Transfer microcentrifuge tube adjacent to microplate.
Move conical tube from slot 1 to slot 3 inside rack A.
Position pipette tip 1cm above the mouth of the conical tube.
Move end-effector downward 1.5cm onto pipette plunger to dispense reagent.
Position wrist camera 12cm above centrifuge rotor to inspect balance.
Perform decontamination wipe sweep across right lab bench zone.
Perform decontamination wipe sweep across left lab bench zone.
Transfer conical tube from rack B to workbench center staging zone.
Transfer microtube to workbench center staging zone.
Position pipette over microplate well H12 corner.
Position pipette tip over microtube loaded in centrifuge rotor.
Touch the centrifuge lid latch to confirm secure closure.
Position gripper pads against 96-well microplate skirt border.
Position gripper over conical tube cap to verify threaded seal.
Press downward 1cm on microtube flip-top cap to verify closure.
Position wrist camera 15cm above benchtop center for workspace audit.
Retract arm upward and return to laboratory standby posture.
Assemble full mechanical transmission: seat shaft into jig bore, mesh spur gear onto shaft, and insert locking dowel pin.
Mesh spur gear onto transmission shaft and insert locking dowel pin into fixture.
Pick completed transmission assembly from fixture, transfer to QA pallet, and trigger optical inspection scan.
Build cheeseburger core: pick sizzling patty from grill onto bottom bun, then top with cheddar cheese slice.
Assemble full gourmet burger: stack patty on bun, add cheese slice, add tomato slice, and crown with top sesame bun.
Transfer assembled gourmet burger from cutting board onto porcelain dining plate for table service.
Complete espresso preparation: place mug under brew spout, actuate brew button, and transfer mug to breakfast tray.
Load coffee capsule into machine hopper and press brew button.
Sort all tabletop items: deposit red block into red bin, green cylinder into green bin, and blue block into blue bin.
Sort red cube into red bin and blue cube into blue bin.
Prepare PCR assay: retrieve micropipette, aspirate sample from conical tube, and dispense into 96-well microplate.
Load microcentrifuge tube into rotor and actuate instrument start button.
Transfer conical tube from rack A to rack B, then transfer microtube into centrifuge.
Kit complete transmission assembly set: kit shaft, gear, and dowel pin onto outbound staging pallet.
Place coffee mug and coffee pod together onto the breakfast serving tray.
Transfer patty to plate and perform sanitation wipe pass over grill station.
Seat shaft in jig bore and actuate fixture vice clamping jaw.
Remove pin from fixture, unmesh gear, and transfer shaft back to inbound tray.
Construct 3-block pyramid: place blue block base, stack green cylinder, and top with red block.
Assemble classic burger and place breakfast coffee mug onto tray.
Transfer used conical tube from rack to waste bin and wipe decontamination zone.
Retrieve rejected shaft from pallet, reseat in fixture, and trigger inspection dwell.
Transfer red block from red bin into blue bin and blue block into red bin.
Clear serving plate, transfer burger components to storage caddies, and wipe board.
Transfer conical tube to microcentrifuge, perform cycle, and return to rack.
Verify andon tower green light, inspect fixture bore, and kit initial shaft from pallet.
Rapid commercial burger build: bun -> patty -> cheese -> crown top bun -> plate.
Clear tabletop center: sort all blocks into perimeter bins and park arm at home.
Retrieve pipette -> aspirate from conical tube -> dispense into microplate -> dock pipette.
Execute Grand Challenge Task 150: Multi-station cross-domain precision assembly, tool manipulation, and optical verification.
Pick the splined shaft, seat it into the bearing bushing, and toggle the fixture clamp down.
Pick the bronze gear, mesh onto the seated shaft, and place the retaining washer on top.
Pick locating dowel pin, insert into guide hole, and seat with downward pressure dwell.
Pick flange bolt from feeder, thread into tapped boss, and confirm seating alignment.
Pick electrical terminal lug, route along cable channel, and snap into retention clip.
Insert bronze sleeve bushing into jig, insert drive shaft, and rotate for concentricity.
Pick micropipette, aspirate 100uL from vial A, and dispense into microplate well C4.
Transfer test tube into centrifuge bucket, close lid, and return tube to rack A.
Grasp micro-centrifuge tube, snap cap closed, and dock into thermal cycler block.
Pick pipette tip from rack, aspirate reagent, and eject used tip into biohazard bin.
Transfer buffer solution to sample vial, swirl gently, and place on magnetic stirrer.
Pick glass cover slip, align over specimen slide, and position under optical lens.
Seat raw workpiece into milling vise, close primary jaw, and throw secondary toggle lock.
Position roller bearing over bore, align arbor press tool, and press into housing.
Grasp nitrile O-ring, stretch over shaft chamfer, and roll into retention groove.
Pick die-cut gasket, align over bolt holes, and place top manifold cover.
Thread spark plug into test cylinder head, engage socket tool, and torque to stop.
Pick 20A blade fuse from tray, orient prongs, and insert into fuse box slot 4.
Pick QFP microchip with vacuum gripper, align pin 1, and press into socket.
Position proximity sensor in bracket, insert locking pin, and route sensor lead.
Uncap conical tube, decant supernatant into waste flask, and re-cap tube.
Pick adhesive seal sheet, apply over 96-well plate, and burnish across rows.
Fill quartz cuvette with sample, insert into spectrophotometer chamber, and close lid.
Grasp cryovial with insulated tongs, scan barcode, and place in liquid nitrogen rack.
Insert valve core into pneumatic manifold, screw clockwise, and test lever action.
Mount timing pulley on motor shaft, loop drive belt, and engage tensioner idler.
Insert square drive key into shaft keyway, then slide coupler hub over key.
Insert stripped wire into crimp barrel, cycle crimper tool, and perform pull test.
Pick inoculation loop, streak agar plate, and place inverted dish in incubator.
Assemble 3-part micro-fluidic cartridge: seat membrane, attach manifold, and clamp frame.
Flip burger patty with spatula, place cheddar cheese slice, and crown with toasted bun.
Place ceramic mug on espresso drip tray, press brew button, and transfer to saucer.
Cut bread slice on cutting board, place into toaster slot, and retrieve to breakfast plate.
Transfer chopped greens to salad bowl, pour vinaigrette dressing, and toss with tongs.
Spread tomato sauce over pizza dough, sprinkle mozzarella, and slide peel into oven.
Layer sliced turkey and romaine lettuce on bread, place top slice, and cut diagonally.
Place tea bag in porcelain mug, pour hot water from kettle, and set honey spoon beside.
Spread seasoned sushi rice on nori sheet, lay salmon strip, and roll bamboo mat.
Crack egg into mixing bowl, whisk with fork until smooth, and pour into heated skillet.
Flip golden pancake on griddle, stack on service plate, and drizzle maple syrup.
Pick dinner fork and steak knife, align on dinner napkin, and roll for table setting.
Dispense granola into breakfast bowl, pour whole milk from carton, and rest spoon in bowl.
Pick salt and pepper shakers, place into table caddy, and position caddy at center.
Retrieve dried plate from dishrack, inspect surface, and stack in upper cabinet.
Sort soup spoon into silverware organizer tray and push drawer fully closed.
Stack tumblers in sets of three, pick stack, and place neatly on storage shelf.
Gather edges of full trash can liner, cinch drawstrings, and replace with clean bag.
Pick apple and banana from counter, arrange in decorative fruit bowl on dining table.
Twist screw cap off water bottle, fill highball glass, and replace screw cap.
Split warm biscuit in half, spread whipped butter, add strawberry jam, and plate.
Hold crispy taco shell in stand, spoon seasoned ground beef, and garnish with salsa.
Place soup bowl in microwave, fit splatter cover over bowl, and press 1-minute start.
Add frozen berries to blender pitcher, securely seat rubber lid, and press pulse button.
Dump boiled pasta into sink colander, shake dry, and return pasta to marinara pot.
Remove foil capsule, extract cork with lever corkscrew, and pour sample into wine glass.
Unpack milk carton and butter block from grocery tote, and store on middle fridge shelf.
Insert coffee pod into brewer chamber, close lever, brew, and empty pod to waste bin.
Fill silicone ice tray at water tap, wipe bottom dry, and slide into freezer drawer.
Clear dinner plates to bus tub, spray mild cleaner, and wipe tabletop dry with cloth.
Execute Complete Banquet Service: Assemble burger, pour beverage, plate dessert, and clear table.
